verdict.rationale: Bench is a human-plus-software bookkeeping service, and a financial SaaS of this kind could plausibly offer a test or sandbox environment, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a sandbox, test mode or non-production environment. The probes found no OpenAPI spec, llms.txt or developer docs, and every documented feature works on live connected financial accounts.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
